strategy: Black-box equivalence partitioning and boundary analysis of the maxPlayers field on POST /rooms. The four in-scope requirements form two valid equivalence classes (maxPlayers=2 and maxPlayers=8, each expecting HTTP 201) and two invalid boundary classes (maxPlayers=1 just below the lowest in-scope valid value and maxPlayers=9 just above the highest in-scope valid value, each expecting HTTP 400). Exactly four independent scenarios are designed, one per requirement, matching the declared scope of four test scenarios and four test cases; no additional variants are created for the shared fixed preconditions (identity player-a, mode=duel, ranked=false), which are linked explicitly to each scenario via dedicated fixed-input factors backed by REQ-ROOMS-INTERFACE. The observable oracle is limited to the HTTP status code, exactly as declared; no response body fields, authentication variations, missing-field handling, concurrency or dependency behavior are asserted because the sourceSpec declares them out of scope. Each scenario maps to one independent test case using the framework's per-test fixture reset, but the reset itself is a verification-harness detail and is not modeled as a requirement. All in-scope expectations are specified by the requirements and covered by the four scenarios, so no open questions or coverage gaps remain within the declared scope.

scenarios.title: Room creation with valid capacity maxPlayers=2 returns HTTP 201
scenarios.dimension: Input equivalence class: in-scope valid capacity value at the lower valid point of maxPlayers
scenarios.expected: POST /rooms with a JSON body containing maxPlayers=2, mode=duel and ranked=false, issued under identity player-a, responds with HTTP status 201. Only the HTTP status code is asserted.

scenarios.title: Room creation with valid capacity maxPlayers=8 returns HTTP 201
scenarios.dimension: Input equivalence class: in-scope valid capacity value at the upper valid point of maxPlayers
scenarios.expected: POST /rooms with a JSON body containing maxPlayers=8, mode=duel and ranked=false, issued under identity player-a, responds with HTTP status 201. Only the HTTP status code is asserted.

scenarios.title: Room creation with invalid capacity maxPlayers=1 returns HTTP 400
scenarios.dimension: Input boundary rejection: maxPlayers just below the lowest in-scope valid capacity value
scenarios.expected: POST /rooms with a JSON body containing maxPlayers=1, mode=duel and ranked=false, issued under identity player-a, responds with HTTP status 400. Only the HTTP status code is asserted.

scenarios.title: Room creation with invalid capacity maxPlayers=9 returns HTTP 400
scenarios.dimension: Input boundary rejection: maxPlayers just above the highest in-scope valid capacity value
scenarios.expected: POST /rooms with a JSON body containing maxPlayers=9, mode=duel and ranked=false, issued under identity player-a, responds with HTTP status 400. Only the HTTP status code is asserted.
